name: Credits.fm
description: Credits.fm is a public MCP server that lets AI agents look up and resolve music credits and identifiers in real time. It supports fast searches and normalization across core music IDs including ISRC, ISWC, IPI, ISNI, and UPC, helping agents match recordings to works and rightsholders with higher confidence. Use it to enrich metadata, validate identifiers, and power music-aware workflows without authentication. Designed for lightweight, high-signal lookups that can be embedded directly into agent tools and automations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Credits.fm to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Credits.fm to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://credits.fm/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Credits.fm MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Credits.fm scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Credits.fm MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Credits.fm lists 14 MCP tools, including credits_search, credits_resolve_track, credits_resolve_url, credits_lookup_isrc, credits_lookup_iswc, credits_lookup_ipi, credits_lookup_isni, credits_lookup_upc, credits_lookup_artist, credits_lookup_musician, credits_batch_lookup, and credits_publishers_for_songwriter.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Credits.fm?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Credits.fm in media-entertainment on the Manufact MCP catalog include SceneF, HANKOOKILBO MCP, Ticketbox.vn, drawnames, and Coffeetable.
Credits.fm does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Credits.fm is developed by Credits.fm. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
